tools.name: bugsnag_list_organizations
tools.description: List the Bugsnag organizations this token can see. Start here to find organization ids. Data Access API: GET /user/organizations.

tools.name: bugsnag_get_organization
tools.description: Get one organization by id. Data Access API: GET /organizations/{id}.

tools.name: bugsnag_list_projects
tools.description: List the projects (apps being monitored) of an organization. Data Access API: GET /organizations/{organization_id}/projects.

tools.name: bugsnag_get_project
tools.description: Get one project by id, including its API key and settings. Data Access API: GET /projects/{project_id}.

tools.name: bugsnag_list_event_fields
tools.description: List the event fields of a project (the names you can use in filters). Data Access API: GET /projects/{project_id}/event_fields.

tools.name: bugsnag_get_stability_trend
tools.description: Get the release stability trend of a project. Data Access API: GET /projects/{project_id}/stability_trend.

tools.name: bugsnag_list_errors
tools.description: List the errors (grouped exceptions) of a project, with filters and sort. Each error has status, first/last seen, event and user counts. Data Access API: GET /projects/{project_id}/errors.

tools.name: bugsnag_get_error
tools.description: Get one error by id, with its status, assignee, severity and counts. Data Access API: GET /projects/{project_id}/errors/{error_id}.

tools.name: bugsnag_list_error_events
tools.description: List the events (single occurrences) of one error, newest first by default. Events can hold stack traces and user data. Data Access API: GET /projects/{project_id}/errors/{error_id}/events.

tools.name: bugsnag_list_project_events
tools.description: List events across a project, with filters (e.g. a time window via event.since). Data Access API: GET /projects/{project_id}/events.

tools.name: bugsnag_get_event
tools.description: Get one event with its exception, stack trace, breadcrumbs, device and user fields. Data Access API: GET /projects/{project_id}/events/{event_id}.

tools.name: bugsnag_list_error_comments
tools.description: List the comments left on one error. Data Access API: GET /projects/{project_id}/errors/{error_id}/comments.

tools.name: bugsnag_list_releases
tools.description: List the releases of a project. Data Access API: GET /projects/{project_id}/releases.

tools.name: bugsnag_get_release
tools.description: Get one release by id, with its errors and session counts. Data Access API: GET /projects/{project_id}/releases/{release_id}.

tools.name: bugsnag_update_error
tools.description: Change one error: open (reopen), fix, ignore, snooze (with reopenRules), link_issue (needs issue_url) or unlink_issue. It changes the error status for the whole team. Data Access API: PATCH /projects/{project_id}/errors/{error_id}.

tools.name: bugsnag_add_error_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to one error, visible to the team. Data Access API: POST /projects/{project_id}/errors/{error_id}/comments.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: bugsnag_list_error_comments · Private data: bugsnag_list_organizations, bugsnag_get_project · Public sink: bugsnag_add_error_comment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: bugsnag_list_error_comments · Private data: bugsnag_list_organizations, bugsnag_get_project · Public sink: bugsnag_add_error_comment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
